questions.topic: eGurukul · Forensic Medicine - INI CET NOV 2023
questions.stem: A 25 year old man was brought to the casualty in a semiconscious state following a road traffic accident. Which type of injury is unlikely to be seen in this patient?
questions.solutionHtml:
Chop wound
  • Chop wounds are caused by a heavy and sharp weapon.
  • Road traffic accidents are more likely to cause rest of the given wounds.


Ks Narayan Reddy , Essentials Of Forensic Medicine And Toxicology , 33rd Edition, Page No. 195, Review Of Forensic Medicine And Toxicology ( Including Clinical And Pathological Aspects) , Gautam Biswas, 2nd Edition, Page No. 176

questions.topic: eGurukul · Forensic Medicine - INI CET NOV 2023
questions.stem: Cadaveric spasm seen in all except:
questions.solutionHtml:
Traumatic asphyxia
  • Among the given options, cadaveric spasm can be seen in all except traumatic asphyxia.
  • Cadaveric spasm is an instantaneous contraction of the muscles used at the time of death.


Ks Narayan Reddy , Essentials Of Forensic Medicine And Toxicology , 33rd Edition, Page No. 163, Review Of Forensic Medicine And Toxicology ( Including Clinical And Pathological Aspects) , Gautam Biswas, 2nd Edition, Page No. 125

questions.topic: eGurukul · Forensic Medicine - INI CET NOV 2023
questions.stem: Autopsy was conducted on a male with a history of drowning. However on autopsy, no water was found in his lungs and he was labeled a case of dry drowning. What is the cause of death?
questions.solutionHtml:
Laryngospasm
  • Death in dry drowning is due to , sudden inrush of water into larynx or nasopharynx ( laryngeal spasm ) which is sustained


Ks Narayan Reddy , Essentials Of Forensic Medicine And Toxicology , 33rd Edition, Page No. 364, 365, Review Of Forensic Medicine And Toxicology ( Including Clinical And Pathological Aspects) , Gautam Biswas, 2nd Edition, Page No. 155 , 156

questions.topic: eGurukul · Forensic Medicine - INI CET NOV 2023
questions.stem: Which of the following cannot be used for identification of the human body?
questions.solutionHtml:
Nail
  • Nails are least useful in identification.
  • post mortem collection of samples of muscle and bone tissue, bone marrow and teeth for DNA-analysis provides highly informative genotyping results, with a minimal risk of contamination during collection and sampling of the post mortem tissue
  • Blood or muscle can be used as a DNA source for the genetic identification of recently deceased persons. If the post mortem interval increases, bones and teeth are used


https://www.researchgate.net/publication/23664673_Genetic_identification_of_decomposed_cadavers_using_nails_as_DNA_source, https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/abs/pii/S0379073818302986

questions.topic: eGurukul · Forensic Medicine - INI CET NOV 2023
questions.stem: In the 18th century, the British East India company smuggled which of the following drugs to China?
questions.solutionHtml:
Opium
  • To obtain the silver it needed to trade for tea with China, the East India Company smuggled opium from India. Opium was illegal in China, but nevertheless in demand.
  • By 1839, East India Company's sale of opium to China paid for the entire tea trade.


https://www.britannica.com/money/topic/opium-trade/The-Opium-Wars, Ks Narayan Reddy , Essentials Of Forensic Medicine And Toxicology , 33rd Edition, Page No. 584 , 585

questions.topic: eGurukul · Forensic Medicine - INI CET NOV 2023
questions.stem: A 13-year-old female was brought by her mother to the emergency with abdominal pain for a few days. On clinical examination by the RMP, the doctor found that she is 8 weeks pregnant. What should be your immediate next step?

options.label: A
options.text: File an MLC and inform police

options.label: B
options.text: Obtain consent from her mother for genital examination

questions.answerText: File an MLC and inform police
questions.solutionHtml:
File an MLC and inform police
  • The given scenario can be classified as a case of statutory rape. (Sexual intercourse with a minor <18 years of age irrespective of consent).
  • Hence, with respect to medical ethics, a medicolegal case must be registered & police should be informed.
  • Sec 375 IPC - definition of rape
  • Sec 376 IPC - Punishment of rape





Egurukul 4.0 Notes, Forensic Medicine , Sexual Jurisprudence , Pocso Act,Page No. 39

questions.topic: eGurukul · Forensic Medicine - INI CET NOV 2023
questions.stem: In a Firearm injury, blackening surrounding the gunshot entry wound is due to?
questions.solutionHtml:
Smoke deposition

Various gunshot products and their effects are –

  • Flame – burning/singeing
  • Smoke/soot particle – blackening/smudging
  • Gunpowder - tattooing


EGurukul 4.0 Notes , Forensic Medicine , Forensic Ballistics , Estimation Of Range , Page No. 107 , 108, Ks Narayan Reddy , Essentials Of Forensic Medicine And Toxicology , 33rd Edition , Page 226

questions.topic: eGurukul · Forensic Medicine - INI CET NOV 2023
questions.stem: All of the following are used in treatment of Heavy metal poisoning except?
questions.solutionHtml:
Oxime
  • All of the given are used as chelating agents for heavy metal poisonings except oxime.
  • Oximes are used in organophosphorus poisoning


Ks Narayan Reddy , Essentials Of Forensic Medicine And Toxicology , 33rd Edition, Page No. 518

questions.stem: Which does not include Grievous' hurt?

options.label: C
options.text: 7 day’s hospital admission in yellow area

questions.answerText: 7 day’s hospital admission in yellow area
questions.solutionHtml:
7 day’s hospital admission in yellow area
